targets.expr:
sum by(kube_cluster_name, kube_namespace, kube_daemon_set)(kubernetes_state_daemonset_ready{kube_namespace=~"$namespace",kube_cluster_name=~"$cluster"}) /
sum by(kube_cluster_name, kube_namespace, kube_daemon_set)(kubernetes_state_daemonset_desired{kube_namespace=~"$namespace",kube_cluster_name=~"$cluster"})

sum by(kube_cluster_name, kube_namespace, kube_stateful_set)(kubernetes_state_statefulset_replicas_ready{kube_namespace=~"$namespace",kube_cluster_name=~"$cluster"}) /
sum by(kube_cluster_name, kube_namespace, kube_stateful_set)(kubernetes_state_statefulset_replicas_desired{kube_namespace=~"$namespace",kube_cluster_name=~"$cluster"}) > 0

sum by(kube_cluster_name, kube_namespace, kube_replica_set)(kubernetes_state_replicaset_replicas_ready{kube_namespace=~"$namespace",kube_cluster_name=~"$cluster"}) /
sum by(kube_cluster_name, kube_namespace, kube_replica_set)(kubernetes_state_replicaset_replicas_desired{kube_namespace=~"$namespace",kube_cluster_name=~"$cluster"}) > 0
